subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris has been successfully confirmed. Your itinerary details are attached to this email for your reference. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before your scheduled departure time. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
